integrity: Self-contained analytic uniqueness proof and complete finite numerical checker are embedded. Known general Toeplitz matrix reduction is attributed, not claimed as new. Closest published centered-half-line Hermite claim and relevant primary sources compared. Historical priority is not independently guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns the full order-two polyanalytic Fock step-symbol fiber and only the first two normalized Hermite functions; higher orders, finite strips, other masks, non-step symbols, and global Schatten traces are not covered. Decimal threshold and maximum evaluations are approximate, not certified intervals.
title: Two off-centre variance maxima for a two-Hermite half-plane concentration fiber
